periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, angled approximately 45 degrees downward from the medial to lateral edge relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval-elliptical with a visual length-to-width ratio of approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the outer inferior quadrant of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve across the visible posterior margin of the interscapular band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Occupies approximately 35% of the visible torso length between the neck and mid-abdomen.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, estimated at approximately twice the width of the ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Distinctly pointed at the apex, lacking a standard semicircular curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brownish-red pigmentation across the ventral, pelvic, and lower torso fur.
